questions.stem: \(2.5b + 5r = 80\) The given equation describes the relationship between the number of birds, \(b\), and the number of reptiles, \(r\), that can be cared for at a pet care business on a given day. If the business cares for 16 reptiles on a given day, how many birds can it care for on this day?
questions.explanation: Substitute \(r = 16\): \(2.5b + 5(16) = 80 \Rightarrow 2.5b + 80 = 80 \Rightarrow 2.5b = 0 \Rightarrow b = 0\).

questions.stem: \(y = 2x^2 - 21x + 64\), \(y = 3x + a\) In the given system of equations, \(a\) is a constant. The graphs of the equations in the given system intersect at exactly one point, \((x, y)\), in the \(xy\)-plane. What is the value of \(x\)?
questions.explanation: Setting equal: \(2x^2 - 21x + 64 = 3x + a\), so \(2x^2 - 24x + (64 - a) = 0\). For exactly one solution the discriminant is 0, giving \(x = \frac{24}{2 \cdot 2} = 6\) (the repeated root is \(-\frac{-24}{2\cdot 2} = 6\)).

questions.stem: \(x + y = 18\), \(5y = x\) What is the solution \((x, y)\) to the given system of equations?
questions.explanation: Substitute \(x = 5y\) into \(x + y = 18\): \(5y + y = 18 \Rightarrow 6y = 18 \Rightarrow y = 3\), so \(x = 15\). Solution: \((15, 3)\).

questions.stem: \(s + 7r = 27\), \(r = 3\) What is the solution \((r, s)\) to the given system of equations?
questions.explanation: Substitute \(r = 3\): \(s + 7(3) = 27 \Rightarrow s + 21 = 27 \Rightarrow s = 6\). The solution \((r, s)\) is \((3, 6)\).

questions.stem: \(y = 6x + 3\) One of the two equations in a system of linear equations is given. The system has infinitely many solutions. Which equation could be the second equation in this system?
questions.explanation: For infinitely many solutions, the second equation must be equivalent to the first. \(2(y) = 2(6x + 3)\) simplifies to \(y = 6x + 3\), the same line.

questions.stem: \(3y = 4x + 17\), \(-3y = 9x - 23\) The solution to the given system of equations is \((x, y)\). What is the value of \(39x\)?
questions.explanation: Adding the equations: \(0 = 13x - 6\), so \(x = \frac{6}{13}\). Then \(39x = 39 \cdot \frac{6}{13} = 3 \cdot 6 = 18\).

questions.stem: \(y = -3x\), \(4x + y = 15\) The solution to the given system of equations is \((x, y)\). What is the value of \(x\)?
questions.explanation: Substitute \(y = -3x\) into \(4x + y = 15\): \(4x - 3x = 15 \Rightarrow x = 15\).

questions.stem: \(y = 6x + 18\) One of the equations in a system of two linear equations is given. The system has no solution. Which equation could be the second equation in the system?
questions.explanation: The first equation is \(y = 6x + 18\), or \(-6x + y = 18\). A system has no solution when the lines are parallel (same slope, different intercept). \(-6x + y = 22\) has the same slope but a different constant, so the lines never meet.

questions.stem: \(2x + 3y = 7\), \(10x + 15y = 35\) For each real number \(r\), which of the following points lies on the graph of each equation in the \(xy\)-plane for the given system?
questions.explanation: The two equations are equivalent (the second is 5 times the first), so every point on \(2x + 3y = 7\) satisfies both. Solving for \(x\): \(x = \frac{7 - 3y}{2}\). Letting \(y = r\) gives \(x = -\frac{3r}{2} + \frac{7}{2}\), i.e., the point \(\left(-\frac{3r}{2} + \frac{7}{2}, r\right)\).

questions.stem: Jay walks at a speed of 3 miles per hour and runs at a speed of 5 miles per hour. He walks for \(w\) hours and runs for \(r\) hours for a combined total of 14 miles. Which equation represents this situation?
questions.explanation: Distance equals speed times time. Walking distance is \(3w\) and running distance is \(5r\), totaling 14 miles: \(3w + 5r = 14\).

questions.stem: \(4x - 9y = 9y + 5\), \(hy = 2 + 4x\) In the given system of equations, \(h\) is a constant. If the system has no solution, what is the value of \(h\)?
questions.explanation: Rewrite the first equation: \(4x - 18y = 5\), or \(4x = 18y + 5\). The second is \(4x = hy - 2\). For no solution, the lines must be parallel: the coefficients of \(y\) must match while constants differ, so \(h = 18\) (and \(-2 \ne 5\), confirming no solution).

questions.stem: \(3x = 12\), \(-3x + y = -6\) The solution to the given system of equations is \((x, y)\). What is the value of \(y\)?
\(x + 5 = 14\), \(y = 4x^2 + 4\) At what point \((x, y)\) do the graphs of the equations in the given system intersect?

\(2x + 9y = 7\) The given equation is one equation in a system of two linear equations. If the system of equations has at least one solution, which of the following equations could be the other equation in the system? I. \(3x + 13.5y = 10.5\) II. \(3x - 13.5y = 10.5\)
questions.explanation: Equation I is the first equation multiplied by 1.5, so it represents the same line (infinitely many solutions â€” at least one). Equation II has a different slope, so it intersects the first line at exactly one point (also at least one solution). Both work.

questions.stem: \(10x = 110\), \(6x - 63 = y\) The solution to the given system of equations is \((x, y)\). What is the value of \(y\)?
If \(x + y = 7\) and \(x - y = 3\), what is the value of \(x\)?
questions.explanation: Solving the system gives \(x = 5\) and \(y = 2\). So \(x = 5\).

questions.stem: If \(x + y = 7\) and \(x - y = 3\), what is the value of \(y\)?
questions.explanation: Solving the system gives \(x = 5\) and \(y = 2\). So \(y = 2\).

questions.stem: If \(2x + y = 7\) and \(x - y = 2\), what is the value of \(x\)?
questions.explanation: Solving the system gives \(x = 3\) and \(y = 1\). So \(x = 3\).

questions.stem: If \(x + 2y = 6\) and \(x - y = 3\), what is the value of \(y\)?
questions.explanation: Solving the system gives \(x = 4\) and \(y = 1\). So \(y = 1\).

questions.stem: If \(x + y = 10\) and \(2x + y = 16\), what is the value of \(x\)?
questions.explanation: Solving the system gives \(x = 6\) and \(y = 4\). So \(x = 6\).

questions.stem: If \(x + y = 10\) and \(2x + y = 17\), what is the value of \(y\)?
questions.explanation: Solving the system gives \(x = 7\) and \(y = 3\). So \(y = 3\).

questions.stem: If \(3x + y = 9\) and \(x - y = -1\), what is the value of \(x + y\)?
questions.explanation: Solving the system gives \(x = 2\) and \(y = 3\). So \(x + y = 5\).

questions.stem: If \(x + y = 11\) and \(x + 2y = 14\), what is the value of \(x\)?
questions.explanation: Solving the system gives \(x = 8\) and \(y = 3\). So \(x = 8\).

questions.stem: If \(2x - y = 6\) and \(x + y = 6\), what is the value of \(y\)?
questions.explanation: Solving the system gives \(x = 4\) and \(y = 2\). So \(y = 2\).

questions.stem: If \(x - 2y = 3\) and \(2x + y = 11\), what is the value of \(x\)?
questions.explanation: Solving the system gives \(x = 5\) and \(y = 1\). So \(x = 5\).

questions.stem: If \(x + y = 9\) and \(3x - y = 7\), what is the value of \(x - y\)?
questions.explanation: Solving the system gives \(x = 4\) and \(y = 5\). So \(x - y = -1\).

questions.stem: If \(2x + 3y = 16\) and \(x - y = -2\), what is the value of \(x + y\)?
questions.explanation: Solving the system gives \(x = 2\) and \(y = 4\). So \(x + y = 6\).

questions.stem: If \(x + 4y = 14\) and \(x + y = 5\), what is the value of \(y\)?
questions.explanation: Solving the system gives \(x = 2\) and \(y = 3\). So \(y = 3\).

questions.stem: Two pencils and one pen cost \(5\) dollars. One pencil and one pen cost \(4\) dollars. What is the cost of one pen, in dollars?
questions.explanation: Subtracting the equations \((2p + q) - (p + q) = 5 - 4\) gives \(p = 1\) (pencil). Then \(q = 4 - 1 = 3\) dollars.

questions.stem: The sum of two numbers is \(20\) and their difference is \(6\). What is the larger number?
questions.explanation: Adding \(x + y = 20\) and \(x - y = 6\) gives \(2x = 26\), so \(x = 13\).

questions.stem: An adult ticket costs \(9\) dollars and a child ticket \(5\) dollars. A family buys \(2\) adult and \(3\) child tickets. What is the total cost, in dollars?
A number \(x\) is twice a number \(y\), and \(x + y = 18\). What is \(y\)?
Three apples and two bananas cost \(7\) dollars. An apple costs \(1\) dollar. What does a banana cost, in dollars?
questions.explanation: With apples at \(1\): \(3(1) + 2b = 7\), so \(2b = 4\) and \(b = 2\) dollars.

questions.stem: The perimeter of a rectangle is \(30\), and its length is \(3\) more than its width. What is the width?
A jar has nickels and dimes totaling \(8\) coins worth \(65\) cents. How many dimes are there?
Two numbers add to \(15\). One is four times the other. What is the smaller number?
A store sells notebooks at \(3\) dollars and folders at \(2\) dollars. Someone buys \(4\) notebooks and some folders for \(20\) dollars total. How many folders?
The difference of two numbers is \(10\) and their sum is \(24\). What is the smaller number?
questions.explanation: From \(x + y = 24\) and \(x - y = 10\), subtracting gives \(2y = 14\), so \(y = 7\).

questions.stem: A bike costs \(3\) times as much as a helmet. Together they cost \(160\) dollars. What does the helmet cost, in dollars?
Two coffees and a muffin cost \(11\) dollars; one coffee and a muffin cost \(7\) dollars. What does one coffee cost, in dollars?
questions.explanation: Subtracting the equations gives one coffee \(= 11 - 7 = 4\) dollars.

questions.stem: A rectangle's length is twice its width, and its perimeter is \(36\). What is the length?
If \(3x + 2y = 14\) and \(2x - y = 7\), what is the value of \(x\)?
questions.explanation: Solving the system gives \(x = 4\) and \(y = 1\). So \(x = 4\).

questions.stem: If \(3x + 2y = 14\) and \(2x - y = 7\), what is the value of \(y\)?
questions.explanation: Solving the system gives \(x = 4\) and \(y = 1\). So \(y = 1\).

questions.stem: If \(2x + 3y = 12\) and \(4x - y = 10\), what is the value of \(x\)?
questions.explanation: Solving the system gives \(x = 3\) and \(y = 2\). So \(x = 3\).

questions.stem: If \(5x + 2y = 12\) and \(3x - 4y = 2\), what is the value of \(y\)?
questions.explanation: Solving the system gives \(x = 2\) and \(y = 1\). So \(y = 1\).

questions.stem: If \(4x - 3y = 6\) and \(2x + 5y = 16\), what is the value of \(x + y\)?
questions.explanation: Solving the system gives \(x = 3\) and \(y = 2\). So \(x + y = 5\).

questions.stem: If \(3x + 4y = 18\) and \(5x - 2y = 4\), what is the value of \(x\)?
questions.explanation: Solving the system gives \(x = 2\) and \(y = 3\). So \(x = 2\).

questions.stem: If \(2x + 5y = 5\) and \(3x + 2y = 13\), what is the value of \(y\)?
questions.explanation: Solving the system gives \(x = 5\) and \(y = -1\). So \(y = -1\).

questions.stem: If \(6x + y = 10\) and \(2x - 3y = -10\), what is the value of \(x - y\)?
questions.explanation: Solving the system gives \(x = 1\) and \(y = 4\). So \(x - y = -3\).

questions.stem: If \(3x - 2y = 2\) and \(4x + 3y = 31\), what is the value of \(x\)?
questions.explanation: Solving the system gives \(x = 4\) and \(y = 5\). So \(x = 4\).

questions.stem: If \(5x + 3y = 9\) and \(2x + 7y = -8\), what is the value of \(x + y\)?
questions.explanation: Solving the system gives \(x = 3\) and \(y = -2\). So \(x + y = 1\).

questions.stem: If \(7x + 2y = 13\) and \(3x - y = 0\), what is the value of \(y\)?
questions.explanation: Solving the system gives \(x = 1\) and \(y = 3\). So \(y = 3\).

questions.stem: If \(4x + 5y = 28\) and \(6x - y = 8\), what is the value of \(x\)?
questions.explanation: Solving the system gives \(x = 2\) and \(y = 4\). So \(x = 2\).

questions.stem: A theater sold \(200\) tickets for \(1{,}400\) dollars. Adult tickets are \(9\) dollars and student tickets \(5\) dollars. How many adult tickets were sold?
A chemist mixes a \(20\%\) solution with a \(50\%\) solution to make \(30\) liters of \(30\%\) solution. How many liters of the \(20\%\) solution are used?
The sum of two numbers is \(50\). Three times the smaller equals twice the larger. What is the larger number?
A boat travels \(24\) miles downstream in \(2\) hours and the same \(24\) miles upstream in \(3\) hours. What is the speed of the boat in still water, in miles per hour?
questions.explanation: Downstream \(b + c = 12\), upstream \(b - c = 8\). Adding: \(2b = 20\), so \(b = 10\) miles per hour.

questions.stem: Two angles are complementary. One is \(30\) degrees larger than the other. What is the measure of the smaller angle, in degrees?
questions.explanation: With \(x + y = 90\) and \(x - y = 30\): subtracting gives \(2y = 60\), so \(y = 30\) degrees.

questions.stem: A vendor sells hot dogs for \(3\) dollars and drinks for \(2\) dollars. In one hour he sells \(20\) items for \(52\) dollars. How many hot dogs did he sell?
questions.explanation: With \(h + d = 20\) and \(3h + 2d = 52\): substitute \(d = 20 - h\) to get \(3h + 40 - 2h = 52\), so \(h = 12\).

questions.stem: The tens digit of a two-digit number is \(2\) more than the units digit, and the digits sum to \(12\). What is the number?
A \(10\)-pound mixture of nuts costs \(6\) dollars per pound. Peanuts cost \(4\) dollars per pound and cashews \(9\) dollars per pound. How many pounds of cashews are in the mix?
Alice is \(4\) years older than Ben. In \(2\) years, the sum of their ages will be \(30\). How old is Ben now?
A gym offers plan A at \(30\) dollars plus \(2\) dollars per visit and plan B at \(10\) dollars plus \(4\) dollars per visit. At how many visits do the plans cost the same?
A rectangle has perimeter \(44\) and its length is \(4\) less than \(3\) times its width. What is the width?
The sum of two numbers is \(3\) and twice the first minus the second is \(12\). What is the first number?
questions.explanation: With \(x + y = 3\) and \(2x - y = 12\): adding gives \(3x = 15\), so \(x = 5\).

questions.stem: A farmer has chickens and cows totaling \(30\) animals with \(74\) legs. How many cows are there?
The system \(\begin{cases} 3x + ky = 12 \\ 6x + 4y = 7 \end{cases}\) has no solution. What is \(k\)?
questions.explanation: No solution means the lines are parallel: equal slopes. From \(3x + ky = 12\), slope \(= -\tfrac{3}{k}\); from \(6x + 4y = 7\), slope \(= -\tfrac{6}{4} = -\tfrac32\). Setting \(\tfrac{3}{k} = \tfrac32\) gives \(k = 2\).

questions.stem: For what value of \(c\) does the system \(\begin{cases} 2x - 3y = 5 \\ 4x - 6y = c \end{cases}\) have infinitely many solutions?
questions.explanation: Infinitely many solutions requires the second equation to be a multiple of the first. Multiplying \(2x - 3y = 5\) by \(2\) gives \(4x - 6y = 10\), so \(c = 10\).

questions.stem: A two-digit number equals \(7\) times the sum of its digits. Reversing its digits gives a number \(18\) less than the original. What is the original number?
questions.explanation: Let the number be \(10t + u\). Then \(10t + u = 7(t + u)\) gives \(3t = 6u\), so \(t = 2u\). Also \((10t + u) - (10u + t) = 18\) gives \(9(t - u) = 18\), so \(t - u = 2\). With \(t = 2u\): \(u = 2\), \(t = 4\); the number is \(42\).

questions.stem: Three pens and two notebooks cost \(16\) dollars, while two pens and five notebooks cost \(18\) dollars. What is the total cost of one pen and one notebook, in dollars?
questions.explanation: With \(3p + 2n = 16\) and \(2p + 5n = 18\): solving gives \(p = 4\) and \(n = 2\), so \(p + n = 6\) dollars.
